interpretation: Legal mapping proxy is the largest measured component at1.100s/36.4% of these profiled stages, closely followed by combined history/encoding/key validation and JSON decoding. It excludes real softmax/probability validation and GPU output handling.

The history/encoding timer is not evidence that feature planes cost0.97s: actual encode_position cumulative time is0.184s and extra features0.030s; history reconstruction dominates that composite instead.
JSON raw_decode accounts for0.808s of0.874s decode stage; this sample implicates JSON parsing more than the combined UTF8/decompression remainder, without separately measuring every C decoder call.
Normal label_shard does not invoke full verify_shard reconstruction; full verifier is reserved for verify-all. No evidence supports deleting identity validation to gain speed.
limitations: cProfile changes relative Python/C costs and especially charges the many calls targeted by reuse. Percentages are descriptive of instrumented subset only.
One early source prefix is not representative proof for all100M positions or later game phases.

GPU inference, softmax, final array validation/hash, compression/write, repeated bank inventory and session setup are absent from stage measurements. No end-to-end throughput estimate or strong pool-vs-reuse speed ranking is established.
No code, live process, receipt or runtime was changed by this analysis.

main_comparison.finding: All three files unchanged between qualified live code commit021124eeaff67a465e000a06a4a2e3b977afc801 and inspected origin/main. Raw labeler SHA independently equal on current live file and main blob.

measurements.identity: All1024 original input keys verified; source dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime unchanged; saved source-qualified row/fingerprint and feature hashes.
measurements.scope: First original closed run06 shard prefix; one core; cProfile enabled; actual frozen Python3.10/NumPy1.26.2; no inference or sidecar writes.

parity_requirements: Exact legal move order, teacher index vector and compact index vector versus current implementation on both colors, castling, en passant, all promotions/underpromotions, checks/pins and terminal positions.

Exact float64 probabilities then stored float32 sidecar arrays for finite logits and current nonfinite-logit fill behavior; preserve zero illegal mass, unit mass, entropy/top1 totals and missing mapping/duplicate/out-of-range refusal.

A tiny actual label_shard path with a deterministic fake session must match all content arrays and hashes, row order, source/input/game/ply identities and source/teacher provenance; publication timestamp/output path may differ. No GPU required.

After implementation and parity review, one bounded unprofiled old/new comparison on the same already selected bank can assess preparation cost; do not rerun real teacher inference or infer end-to-end label throughput from this CPU test.

recommendation.bounded_scope: Main-based change in bt4_policy_dump.py and raw sidecar consumer, plus focused parity tests; keep legacy legal_move_policy(board, logits)->(ucis, probs) API intact via shared internal computation. No driver, multiprocessing, lease, encoder, data format or decoder change.
recommendation.design: Build list(board.legal_moves) once in a shared helper that owns legality enumeration, computes teacher indices directly from Move objects, and returns that list plus probabilities. Apply existing float64 legal-logit gather, nonfinite replacement, exp/max/sum normalization in unchanged order. Existing public legal_move_policy adapts moves to UCIs, preserving its API. Raw consumer computes compact indices once from the returned full legal Move list and retains injectivity, count/range, finite/nonnegative/unit-mass checks and zero illegal output. Other callers do not acquire unnecessary compact-index work. Do not add a cross-position cache or trust caller-supplied unverified move lists.
recommendation.effect_expected_from_structure: For this subset, remove the second27425 compact conversions, remove54850 UCI-to-Move round trips from mapping, and remove the second board legal-move enumeration. Preserve all teacher-index conversions and numerical normalization. This predicts less repeated CPU work, not a measured speedup.
recommendation.guard_semantics: The old expected set recomputes the same compact converter over a second legal enumeration; it is not an independent mapping implementation. Replace the redundant re-enumeration with a helper whose internally enumerated full legal move list is the source of count/coverage, retaining uniqueness/range checks and independent teacher mapping. Do not merely delete coverage checks at an arbitrary caller boundary.
recommendation.priority: Reuse one per-position legal Move list and its teacher/compact indices before introducing a CPU pool.
recommendation.why_before_pool: The duplicated work is localized and removable without adding worker lifetime, IPC, buffering, row-order or CPU contention behavior. A pool may later help both JSON and history but is a larger unmeasured intervention.
